title: Yogesh @ Sachin Jagdish Joshi v. State of Maharashtra

content.caseIdentity: Yogesh @ Sachin Jagdish Joshi v. State of Maharashtra, (2008) 10 SCC 394
content.holding: Reaffirmed that to frame a charge or convict for criminal conspiracy, the prosecution must show a meeting of minds (consensus ad idem) to do an illegal act; suspicion and conjectures cannot take the place of legal proof.
